vv50:1.1: vaṇṇena yā tvaṃ tiṭṭhasi devate hatthe pāde ca viggayha naccasi suppavādite. || ||
vv50:2.1: Tassā te naccamānāya aṅga-m-aṅgehi sabbaso dibbā saddā niccharanti savanīyā manoramā. || ||
vv50:3.1: Tassā te naccamānāya aṅga-m-aṅgehi sabbaso dibbā gandhā pavāyanti sucigandhā manoramā. || ||
vv50:4.1: Vivattamānā kāyena yā veṇīsu pilandhanā tesaṃ suyyati nigghoso turiye pañcaṅgike yathā. || ||
vv50:5.1: Vaṭamsakā vātadhutā vātena sampakampitā tesaṃ suyyati nigghoso turiye pañcaṅgike yathā. || ||
vv50:6.1: Yā pi te sirasmiṃ mālā sucigandhā manoramā vāti gandho disā sabbā rukkho mañjūsako yathā. || ||
vv50:7.1: Ghāyase taṃ sucigandhaṃ rūpaṃ passasi amānusaṃ devate pucchitācikkha kissa kammass' idaṃ phalan ti. || ||
vv50:8.1: Dāsī ahaṃ pure āsiṃ Gayāyaṃ brāhmaṇass' ahaṃ appapuññā alakkhikā Rajjumālā ti maṃ vidū. || || Akkosānaṃ
vv50:9.1: vadhānañ ca tajjanāya ca ukkatā kuṭaṃ gahetvā nikkhamma gacchiṃ udakahāriyā. || ||
vv50:10.1: Vipathe kuṭaṃ nikkhipitvā vanasaṇḍaṃ upāgamiṃ: idh' evāhaṃ marissāmi kvattho pi jīvitena me. || ||
vv50:11.1: Daḷhaṃ pāsaṃ karitvāna āsumbhitvāna pādape tato disā vilokesiṃ: ko nu kho vanam assito. || ||
vv50:12.1: Tatth' addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ sabbalokahitaṃ muniṃ nisinnaṃ rukkhamūlasmiṃ jhāyantaṃ akutobhayaṃ. || ||
vv50:13.1: Tassā me ahu saṃvego abbhuto lomahaṃsano: ko nu kho vanam assito manusso udāhu devatā. || ||
vv50:14.1: Pāsādikaṃ pasādanīyaṃ vanā nibbanam āgataṃ disvā mano me pasīdi, nāyaṃ yādisak' īdiso. || ||
vv50:15.1: Guttindriyo jhānarato abahiggatamānaso hito sabbassa lokassa buddho so 'yaṃ bhavissati. || ||
vv50:16.1: Bhayabheravo durāsado sīho va guham assito dullabhāyaṃ dassanāya pupphaṃ odumbaraṃ yathā. || ||
vv50:17.1: So maṃ mudūhi vācāhi ālapitvā tathāgato Rajjumāle ti maṃ voca saraṇaṃ gaccha tathāgataṃ. || ||
vv50:18.1: Tāhaṃ giraṃ suṇitvāna nelaṃ atthavatiṃ suciṃ saṇhaṃ muduñ ca vagguñ ca sabbasokāpanūdanaṃ. || ||
vv50:19.1: Kallacittañ ca maṃ ñatvā pasannaṃ suddhamānasaṃ hito sabbassa lokassa anusāsi tathāgato. || ||
vv50:20.1: Idaṃ dukkhan ti maṃ voca ayaṃ dukkhassa sambhavo ayaṃ nirodho maggo ca añjaso amatogadho. || ||
vv50:21.1: Anukampakassa kusalassa ovādamhi ahaṃ ṭhitā ajjhagā amataṃ santiṃ nibbānaṃ padam accutaṃ. || ||
vv50:22.1: Sāhaṃ avaṭṭhitā pemā dassane avikampinī mūlajātāya saddhāya dhītā buddhassa orasā. || ||
vv50:23.1: Sāhaṃ ramāmi kīḷāmi modāmi akutobhayā dibbaṃ mālaṃ dhārayāmi pivāmi madhu maddavaṃ. || ||
vv50:24.1: Saṭṭhi turiyasahassāni paṭibodhaṃ karonti me: Ālambo Gaggaro Bhīmo Sadhuvādī ca Saṃsayo || ||
vv50:25.1: Pokkharo ca Suphasso ca Vīṇāmokkhā ca nāriyo Nandā c' eva Sunandā ca Soṇadinnā Sucimhitā || ||
vv50:26.1: Alambusā Missakesī ca Puṇḍarīkātidāruṇī Eṇiphassā Suphassā ca Subhaddā Muduvādinī || ||
vv50:27.1: Etā c' aññā ca seyyāse accharānaṃ pabodhikā tā maṃ kālen' upāgantvā abhibhāsanti devatā: || ||
vv50:28.1: Handa naccāma gāyāma handa taṃ ramayāmase na-y-idaṃ akatapuññānaṃ katapuññānam ev' idaṃ. || ||
vv50:29.1: Asokaṃ Nandanaṃ rammaṃ Tidasānaṃ mahāvanaṃ sukhaṃ akatapuññānaṃ idha natthi parattha ca
vv50:30.1: sukhañ ca katapuññānaṃ idha c' eva parattha ca. || || Tesaṃ sahavyakāmānaṃ kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ bahuṃ katapuññā hi modanti sagge bhogasamaṅgino. || ||
vv50:31.1: Bahunnaṃ vata atthāya uppajjanti tathāgatā dakkhiṇeyyā manussānaṃ puññakkhettānam ākarā yattha kāraṃ karitvāna sagge modanti dāyakā ti. || ||
vv50:34.1: Mañjeṭṭhā Pabhassarā nāgā Alomā kañjikadāyikā vihāra-caturitthambā pītā ucchu-vandana-Rajjumālā; vaggo tena pavuccatī ti.
